remarks: Look no further! Single family property for rent in the HEART of SONO. Conveniently located just minutes away from many shops/restaurants on Washington St, Sono Collection Mall, I95 (Ex 14,15), South Norwalk Train Station, Calf Pasture Beach, Maritime Aquarium & MORE! Property has been completely renovated and has been maintained beautifully both inside & out by owners & current tenants. Main level has a spacious open floor plan with high ceilings, recessed lighting & plenty of windows for natural light. Main level includes an open living room, dining room, tastefully updated kitchen & 1 full bathroom. Plenty of cabinets & closets for storage! Main level leads to front enclosed sun room/porch area, rear deck area PERFECT for grilling & relaxing AND basement storage/laundry area. Upstairs you will find 3 commodious bedrooms, 1 full bathroom & a walkup stairwell leading to a finished 350 sq ft attic/office area! Natural Gas for HEAT/HOT WATER, SNEW ELECTRIC & good insulation keep the UTILITIES LOW! Window units for AC. Tenant responsible for ALL utilities, ground maintenance & Water Usage. Plenty of Parking on STREET. Beautiful front/side yard for entertaining + FENCED. Pets CASE BY CASE BASIS! Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income & references. **Washer/Dryer belong to current tenant but can be purchased** 24 HR NOTICE REQUIRED FOR SHOWINGS**
